## Course feedback form
Please help us improve the course and the materials we provide by completing the course feedback form **[here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfah66t6TKM4tlYb7lG2mKUOvCjZTyFWsRBH3TMwgVy50AW6g/viewform?usp=dialog)**.

## Location
The course will take place at [Conference Center Wallenberg](https://motesservice.gu.se/en/conference-centre-wallenberg), located at [Medicinaregatan 20](https://share.google/XuKsbsGch6mOFpX6I).

Our room is **Antarctis**. The room is located on the ground floor — turn left after entering through the main entrance and look for the SND logo.

## Transport
The nearest tram stop is **Göteborg Medicinaregatan**. Public transport in Gothenburg can be paid for directly by tapping a credit card. Alternatively, you can purchase tickets and plan your journey using the [Västtrafik To Go app](https://www.vasttrafik.se/biljetter/mer-om-biljetter/vasttrafik-to-go/).

There is ample parking available close to the venue. Parking fees can be paid using standard commercial parking apps.

## Fika & lunch
The 2500 SEK course fee includes afternoon coffee and light refreshments on 4 May, and lunch together with morning and afternoon coffee and refreshments on the remaining days (5–7 May).

## Credits
Suggested course credits: **2 hp**

> **Note:** SND can only provide a suggested number of credits. After completing the course, you must apply to your university department for formal credit approval.
